newsitem.title: UK: John D Wood shares advance after bid report.
newsitem.headline: John D Wood shares advance after bid report.

text.p: Shares in estate agency group John D Wood Plc rose in early trade on Monday after a report in the Sunday Times said bidders including Hambro Countrywide were hovering around the company.
John D Wood shares were up 10p at 145 by 0758 GMT in volume of 16,279 shares.
The Sunday Times said Hambro Countrywide was keen to add to its presence in the estate agency business in London having recently acquired small London chain Faron Sutaria for 7.45 million stg.
John D Wood said last week it had received an approach which could lead to a bid gave no further detail.
No-one at Hambro Countrywide was immediately available for comment.
